eidolons.name: My Sword Stirs Starlight
eidolons.desc: When Shifu is on the field, increases March 7th's SPD by 10%.

eidolons.name: Blade Dances on Waves' Fight
eidolons.desc: After "Shifu" uses Basic ATK or Skill to attack an enemy target, March 7th immediately launches a Follow-Up ATK and deals Imaginary DMG equal to 60% of March 7th's ATK to the primary target of this attack. Additionally, triggers the corresponding effect based on "Shifu"'s Path and then gains 1 point(s) of Charge. If there is no primary target available to attack, then she attacks a single random enemy instead. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

eidolons.name: Sharp Wit in Martial Might
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Being Fabulous Never Frights
eidolons.desc: At the start of the turn, regenerates 5 Energy.

eidolons.name: Sword Delights, Sugar Blights
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Me, the Best Girl in Sight
eidolons.desc: After using Ultimate, increases the CRIT DMG dealt by the next Enhanced Basic ATK by 50%.

basic.name: My Sword Zaps Demons
basic.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {0}% of March 7th's ATK to one designated enemy target and gains 1 point(s) of Charge.

skill.name: Master, It's Tea Time!
skill.desc:
Designates one ally (excluding this unit) as "Shifu" and increases "Shifu"'s SPD by {0}%. Only the most recent target of March 7th's Skill is considered as "Shifu."
Whenever using Basic ATK or dealing 1 hit of Enhanced Basic ATK's DMG, triggers the corresponding effect if "Shifu" with the specified Path is present on the field:
Erudition, Destruction, The Hunt, Remembrance, Elation: Deals Additional DMG (DMG Type based on "Shifu"'s Combat Type) equal to {1}% of March 7th's ATK.
Harmony, Nihility, Preservation, Abundance: Increases the Toughness Reduction of this instance of DMG by 100%.

ult.name: March 7th, the Apex Heroine
ult.desc:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {0}% of March 7th's ATK to one designated enemy target.
Increases the initial Hits Per Action of the next Enhanced Basic ATK by 2 hit(s) and increase the fixed chance of additionally dealing DMG by 20%.

talent.name: Master, I've Ascended!
talent.desc:
After Shifu uses an attack or Ultimate, March 7th gains up to 1 point of Charge each time.
Upon reaching 7 or more points of Charge, March 7th immediately takes action and increases the DMG she deals by {0}%. Her Basic ATK gets Enhanced, and her Skill cannot be used. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes 7 point(s) of Charge. Charge is capped at 10 points.

extra.name: Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten
extra.desc:
Initially, deals 3 hits, each causing Imaginary DMG equal to {0}% of March 7th's ATK to one designated enemy target. When dealing the final hit, there is a 60% fixed chance to deal 1 additional hit of DMG, up to a max of 3 additional hit(s). Energy regenerated from using Enhanced Basic ATK does not increase with the number of hits.
Enhanced Basic ATK cannot recover Skill Points.

technique.name: Feast in One Go
technique.desc:
If March 7th is on the team, she gains 1 point of Charge at the start of the next battle whenever a teammate uses Technique, up to a max of 3 point(s).
After using Technique, March 7th regenerates 30 Energy when the next battle starts.

ability_1.name: Swan Soar
ability_1.desc: When the battle starts, March 7th's action advances by 25%.

ability_2.name: Filigree
ability_2.desc: March 7th can reduce the Toughness of enemies whose Weakness Type is the same as Shifu's Combat Type. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

ability_3.name: Tide Tamer
ability_3.desc: After using Enhanced Basic ATK, increases Shifu's CRIT DMG by 60% and Break Effect by 36%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

lightCones.name: In the Night
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 18%/21%/24%/27%/30%. While the wearer is in battle, for every 10 SPD that exceeds 100, increases DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill by 6%/7%/8%/9%/10%. At the same time, increases the CRIT DMG of Ultimate by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. This effect can stack up to 6 time(s).

lightCones.name: Baptism of Pure Thought
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 20%/23%/26%/28%/32%. For every debuff on the enemy target, the wearer's CRIT DMG dealt against this target additionally increases by 8%/9%/10%/11%/12%, stacking up to 3 times. When using Ultimate to attack the enemy target, the wearer receives the "Disputation" effect, which increases DMG dealt by 36%/42%/48%/54%/60% and enables their Follow-Up ATKs to ignore 24%/28%/32%/36%/40% of the target's DEF. This effect lasts for 2 turns.

lightCones.name: Cruising in the Stellar Sea
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%/10%/12%/14%/16%, and increases their CRIT Rate against enemies with HP percentage 50% or less by an extra 8%/10%/12%/14%/16%. When the wearer defeats an enemy, their ATK is increased by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40% for 2 turn(s).

lightCones.name: I Venture Forth to Hunt
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 15%/17.5%/20%/22.5%/25%. When the wearer launches a Follow-Up ATK, gains 1 stack of "Luminflux," stacking up to 2 time(s). Each stack of "Luminflux" enables the Ultimate DMG dealt by the wearer to ignore 27%/30%/33%/36%/39% of the target's DEF. When the wearer's turn ends, removes 1 stack of "Luminflux."

lightCones.name: Only Silence Remains
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by 16%/20%/24%/28%/32%. If there are 2 or fewer enemies on the field, increases wearer's CRIT Rate by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%.

lightCones.name: Swordplay
lightCones.description: For each time the wearer hits the same target, DMG dealt increases by 8%/10%/12%/14%/16%, stacking up to 5 time(s). This effect will be dispelled when the wearer changes targets.

relicSets.name: Musketeer of Wild Wheat
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases ATK by 12%. 4-pc: The wearer's SPD increases by 6% and DMG dealt by Basic ATK increases by 10%.

relicSets.name: Pioneer Diver of Dead Waters
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases DMG dealt to enemies with debuffs by 12%. 4-pc: Increases CRIT Rate by 4%. The wearer deals 8%/12% increased CRIT DMG to enemies with at least 2/3 debuffs. After the wearer inflicts a debuff on enemy targets, the aforementioned effects increase by 100%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

relicSets.name: Iron Cavalry Against the Scourge
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases Break Effect by 16%. 4-pc: If the wearer's Break Effect is 150% or higher, the Break DMG dealt to the enemy target ignores 10% of their DEF. If the wearer's Break Effect is 250% or higher, the Super Break DMG dealt to the enemy target additionally ignores 15% of their DEF.

planarSets.name: Rutilant Arena
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When the wearer's current CRIT Rate reaches 70% or higher, DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill increases by 20%.

planarSets.name: Izumo Gensei and Takama Divine Realm
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by 12%. When entering battle, if at least one teammate follows the same Path as the wearer, then the wearer's CRIT Rate increases by 12%.

planarSets.name: Talia: Kingdom of Banditry
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by 16%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 145 or higher, the wearer's Break Effect increases by an extra 20%.

lore.description:
March 7th in a Xianzhou-styled outfit. A sword-wielding female martial artist.
Learning swordplay from both Yunli and Yanqing, she is eager to create more beautiful memories on the Xianzhou.
stories: Visiting the Luofu for the first time, the Ambrosial Arbor crisis, the Wardance... She not only bore witness to the Xianzhou ship's transformation, but also her own growth. The girl in the photograph moved nimbly in the flower grove. Petals rained down as she wielded her sword with vigor, fluttering all over her robes. Was she still the same March 7th from before? Her footwork had become skilled, and she carried herself with poise and composure. Before she knew it, she could already wield her dual swords with confidence... A minor achievement, but one that nevertheless transformed her into a person that she could hardly recognize. "...If I want to know who I really am, then I must find the truth myself." She quietly made up her mind and turned her gaze to the sky, hope and anticipation filling her eyes. Countless stars and endless worlds gazed back upon her, twinkling in the sky as they did. "My past is growing bit by bit each and every day." Indeed, for her past and future, both have gradually taken on new colors.
